limitations: Cellosaurus identifies bEnd.5 as CVCL_2252, but the shared two-template SDRF does not include cell-lines fields because BALB-5023 is primary cultured cells without a Cellosaurus accession; identities remain in source names

The PRIDE paper calls bEnd.5 a tumor endothelial model, but Cellosaurus describes it as polyomavirus-transformed rather than donor-derived endothelioma; disease is not applicable rather than inferred neoplasm

Sequential Lys-C and trypsin are encoded as repeated cleavage-agent columns by the local builder extension; the current reconciliation command inspects only the first repeated column and gives a false incomplete warning.
